name: doomsday-ready-backend
description: Backend API for MCU rewatch planner and cinema bundle booking

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/docs', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/docs/openapi.yaml', 'dist/docs/openapi.yaml'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/db', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('src/db/migrations', 'dist/db/migrations', {recursive:true});"
